Hi Aurelio — welcome, and thank you for the docs. Short answers below and next steps.

What we need to create a vendor master (minimum):
- Legal entity name (exactly as on W-9)
- Tax ID / EIN (masked is fine in email, full can be uploaded to portal)
- Remit address (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
- AP contact name, email, phone
- Invoicing preference (PDF email, EDI, portal upload)
- Primary PO routing contact (who will accept PO and confirm shipments)

Portal steps: I created a one-time onboarding packet in Redwood Vendor Portal and uploaded the packet template you should populate: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_dummy_link
Please attach the completed packet and the W-9 in the portal. If you prefer, reply to this thread with the legal name and remit address and I can start the record and request the signed W-9 to be re-uploaded into the portal for PII security.

SLA: Once we have a complete packet and verified W-9, vendor master creation and PO routing typically takes 3 business days; first invoice clearance depends on ERP mapping but usually within 7 business days. If you need expedited processing, let me know and I can loop in Kimberly for priority setup.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi team — forwarding Northgate's packet. Quick note: the W-9 attached lists "Northgate Supplies LLC" but the bank sheet lists "Northgate Supplies Inc." and their Incorporation doc wasn't included. Tax ID matches both entries (same EIN). Recommend we:
1) Ask external to confirm the legal name as it appears on IRS records (we need the exact legal name for the master).
2) If they confirm LLC vs Inc discrepancy, request a Certificate of Formation or government record and a corrected W-9.
3) If they confirm the EIN is the same and provide an attestation and two corroborating docs (bank letter + invoice header) we can proceed with conditional creation and flag for later remediation.

Kimberly, can you advise on whether AP needs the company formation doc for record creation or if attestation + W-9 is enough for now? Karthik — FYI for PO routing contact assignment once we have the legal name confirmed.

Marissa
